verdicts.reading: Imaginary-coherence lemma on real resting EEG (ds003775): volume conduction dominates coherency in the REAL part (Re/Im = 8.2), and the decisive signature holds -- mixing strength anti-correlates with imaginary coherency (Spearman -0.25); the most-mixed near-electrode pairs have the SMALLEST |Im| (Re/Im = 28, |Im| below the median) and are the LEAST likely to clear the phase-surrogate ceiling.  Imaginary coherency rises with electrode distance (genuine inter-regional coupling) where mixing falls.  P0's surrogate ceiling and Nolte's ImCoh artifact rejection are one lemma: instantaneous mixing is real, so it is invisible to Im.
